{{Quote|The previous Commander of Coruscant Security also made demands for more soldiers, Moff Kadir. You shall make do with what we provide. Unless you'd rather share your predecessor's fate.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="Empire 1">[[Empire 1|''Empire'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Commander of Coruscant Security''' was used as both a general title and a [[police rank]] for the [[Commander/Legends|commanding]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. The title continued to be used during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] despite the fact that the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] "[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]" was renamed "Imperial Center."
